title: SHUCKED – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: SHUCKED Broadway Musical in Springfield, MO, Jan 2027
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical about Maizy and Beau's wedding, a small community whose protective corn starts to die, and a battle for the heart and soil of the town. It features the songs 'Woman of the World', 'Somebody Will' and 'Independently Owned', and is recommended for ages 10+, with adult themes and language. Performances run January 19-21, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO; single tickets are not yet on sale, so subscriptions are the only way to buy for now.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
